say.text: 如何在自定义命令中使用 SDK 客户端调用 API？

howto.what_en: Claude will guide you on how to add custom commands to the server-url-templating-api-single-base-url CLI, including editing custom.rs, registering commands, and using the SDK client.
howto.when_en: When you ask about writing custom commands for this CLI, or about editing custom.rs, registering commands, or using the SDK client.

say_en.text: Add a custom command named my-command for server-url-templating-api.
say_en.note: Claude will provide steps to edit custom.rs and register the command.

say_en.text: How to use the SDK client in a custom command to call an API?
say_en.note: Claude will explain client() and block_on() usage.
